sections.heading: Built Around the Needs of International Travelers
body: 24/7 Clinic has developed a network of urgent care centers and on-site hotel clinics across Egypt’s leading tourism destinations.
Unlike traditional medical facilities, our model places medical care where international travelers are already staying. inside hotels and resorts.
Our medical teams provide urgent and primary care, coordinate with international insurers and assistance companies, and arrange higher-level hospital care when medically required.
